description:
Redeem 3.0+ Adult BMX Bike

Vacuum Coating Frame - Sleek gloss jelly paint makes the bike more attractive.
V-brake - Ensure the safety of riders.

2 Pegs - Increase the way of riding and have fun.
Professional Drivetrain - Features the most professional combination for bmx bike - 36T chain ring and 18T cog freewheel.

High Stability and Comfort

Hi-ten steel frame and components are rugged and built to last. Aluminum alloy stem and high carbon steel handlebar offers excellent stability and comfortability for riders.

The extra long 20.8" top tube fit for riders who need a bit more room between the saddle and the handlebars. High density foam padding makes the seat more comfortable for riders.

Vacuum Coating

Vacuum coating color, as a special technique from Hiland, is cool when riding and adds extra fun.

It can also resist to any dirty kinds of environment.

Safe and Fun Riding

Equipped with aluminum V-brake is lightweight and durable.Front and rear aluminum linear pull handbrakes offer quality speed control, allowing stop quickly in case of an emergency.

2 pegs at front allow riders to try hops and tricks easily, which makes the riding more entertaining.

Professional Drivetrain

The drivetrain features 140 cranks with a 36T chain ring and 18T cog freewheel is the most professional combination for BMX bike, making it easy to ride.

You can enjoy the professional drivetrain with entry-level cost.

Assembly & Guide

85% pre-assembled, free pedals and required assembly tools included, easy to assemble.

Solutions will be quickly provided by support team within 24 hours! Bikes all have been inspected before package. Solve all your worries!

Professional Drivetrain

36T chain ring and 18T cog freewheel is the most professional combination for BMX bike, making it easy to ride.

Vacuum Coating

Hiland special oil slick color is cool and resist to any dirty kinds of environment. Also, built to last with a rugged hi-ten steel frame and components.

Pegs

Front two pegs allow rider to try hops and tricks easily.

V-brake

V-brake is lighter and easier to maintain and adjust.

Elevate your ride with the Hiland Redeem 3.0+ Adult BMX Bike. Featuring a stunning vacuum-coated finish, professional 36T/18T drivetrain, and front pegs, this 24"/26" BMX is built for performance and style.
